ud5.6:9.1: atha kho āyasmā mahākaccāno soṇaṃ upāsakaṃ koṭikaṇṇaṃ pabbājesi.
ud5.6:9.2: tena kho pana samayena avantidakkhiṇāpatho appabhikkhuko hoti.
ud5.6:9.3: atha kho āyasmā mahākaccāno tiṇṇaṃ vassānaṃ accayena kicchena kasirena tato tato dasavaggaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ sannipātetvā āyasmantaṃ soṇaṃ upasampādesi.
ud5.6:10.1: atha kho āyasmato soṇassa vassaṃ vuṭṭhassa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi
ud5.6:10.2: na kho me so bhagavā sammukhā diṭṭho api ca suto yeva me
ud5.6:10.3: so bhagavā īdiso ca īdiso cāti
ud5.6:10.4: sace maṃ upajjhāyo anujāneyya gaccheyyāhaṃ taṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhanti.
ud5.6:11.1: atha kho āyasmā soṇo sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā mahākaccāno tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ mahākaccānaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
ud5.6:11.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā soṇo āyasmantaṃ mahākaccānaṃ etadavoca
ud5.6:12.1: idha mayhaṃ bhante rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi
ud5.6:12.2: na kho me so bhagavā sammukhā diṭṭho api ca suto yeva me
ud5.6:12.3: so bhagavā īdiso ca īdiso cāti
ud5.6:12.4: sace maṃ upajjhāyo anujāneyya gaccheyyāhaṃ taṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhanti.
ud5.6:13.2: gaccha tvaṃ soṇa taṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhanti
ud5.6:13.3: dakkhissasi tvaṃ soṇa taṃ bhagavantaṃ pāsādikaṃ pāsādanīyaṃ santindriyaṃ santamānasaṃ uttamasamathadamathamanuppattaṃ dantaṃ guttaṃ yatindriyaṃ nāgaṃ
ud5.6:13.4: disvāna mama vacanena bhagavato pāde sirasā vandāhi appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ pucchāti.
ud5.6:14.1: evaṃ bhanteti kho āyasmā soṇo āyasmato mahākaccānassa bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā āyasmantaṃ mahākaccānaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā senāsanaṃ saṃsāmetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena sāvatthī tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
ud5.6:14.2: anupubbena cārikañcaramāno yena sāvatthī jetavanaṃ anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāmo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
ud5.6:14.3: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā soṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
ud5.6:14.4: upajjhāyo me bhante āyasmā mahākaccāno bhagavato pāde sirasā vandati appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ pucchatīti.
ud5.6:15.1: kacci bhikkhu khamanīyaṃ kacci yāpanīyaṃ kaccipi appakilamathena addhānaṃ āgato na ca piṇḍakena kilantosīti.
ud5.6:15.2: khamanīyaṃ bhagavā yāpanīyaṃ bhagavā appakilamathena cāhaṃ bhante addhānaṃ āgato na ca piṇḍakena kilantomhīti.
ud5.6:16.1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi
ud5.6:16.5: imassa ānanda āgantukassa bhikkhuno senāsanaṃ paññāpehīti icchati bhagavā tena bhikkhunā saddhiṃ ekavihāre vatthuṃ icchati bhagavā āyasmatā soṇena saddhiṃ ekavihāre vatthunti.
ud5.6:16.6: yasmiṃ vihāre bhagavā viharati tasmiṃ vihāre āyasmato soṇassa senāsanaṃ paññāpesi.
ud5.6:17.1: atha kho bhagavā bahudeva rattiṃ abbhokāse nipajjāya vītināmetvā pāde pakkhāletvā vihāraṃ pāvisi.
ud5.6:17.2: āyasmāpi kho soṇo bahudeva rattiṃ abbhokāse nipajjāya vītināmetvā pāde pakkhāletvā vihāraṃ pāvisi.
ud5.6:17.3: atha kho bhagavā rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya āyasmantaṃ mahāsoṇaṃ ajjhesi
ud5.6:18.1: evaṃ bhanteti kho āyasmā soṇo bhagavato paṭissutvā soḷasa aṭṭhakavaggikāni sabbāneva sarena abhaṇi.
ud5.6:18.2: atha kho bhagavā āyasmato soṇasas sarabhaññapariyosāne abbhānumodi
ud5.6:18.3: sādhu sādhu bhikkhu suggahitāni bhikkhu aṭṭhakavaggikāni sumanasikatāni supadhāritāni kalyāṇiyāsi vācāya samannāgato visaṭṭhāya anelāya atthassa viññāpaniyā
ud5.6:18.6: kissa pana tvaṃ bhikkhu evaṃ ciraṃ akāsīti.
ud5.6:18.7: ciraṃ diṭṭho me bhante kāmesu ādīnavo
ud5.6:18.8: api ca sambādho gharāvāso bahukicco bahukaraṇīyoti.
